title: Remembering Allah During Success
paragraphs: After his small business finally became profitable following years of struggle, Nizar noticed himself feeling proud of his own effort, occasionally forgetting to attribute his success to anything beyond his own hard work.

A close friend gently reminded him during a conversation that the same effort could have easily produced a different outcome, and that gratitude toward Allah should not fade simply because things had gone well.

This reminder made Nizar pause and reflect, and he began deliberately setting aside a portion of his new profits for charity, treating his success as a trust rather than something entirely earned alone.

Reflecting later, Nizar realized that remembering Allah during ease was, in some ways, more difficult than remembering Him during hardship, precisely because success rarely demanded the same reflection.
